name: Mir Sazzat Hossain
description:
A highly motivated and aspiring researcher with a strong background in deep learning, with recent work centered on multimodal learning. Over the past few years, I have actively contributed to the field, publishing research articles in top-tier venues such as ACL and WACV. My primary research interests now lie in preference optimization and reinforcement learning for large language models. I have also worked on vision-language models, domain adaptation, and federated learning, and continue to explore these areas with strong interest.

Currently, I am working as a Research Assistant at the Center for Computational & Data Sciences (CCDS) at Independent University, Bangladesh. My recent work explores multimodal alignment and efficient adaptation, and I am increasingly focused on LLM scaling, test-time adaptation, self-distillation, adversarial policy optimization, and formal verification. I am actively seeking Ph.D. opportunities in Computer Science for Fall 2027, with an emphasis on preference optimization and reinforcement learning for large language models.
